description: This Java source file contains integration tests for JWT token verification in a Spring Boot application. It tests various scenarios related to JWT tokens such as invalid, missing, expired, and valid tokens, as well as token refresh functionality.

classes.name: JwtTokenVerifierIntegrationTest
classes.description: A Spring Boot integration test class for verifying JWT token functionality, including authentication, expiration, and refresh token handling.

methods.name: shouldReturnUnauthorizedIfIncorrectRefreshTokenPassed
methods.description: Tests that providing an incorrect refresh token results in an unauthorized response.

methods.name: shouldReturnUnauthorizedIfTokenNotPassed
methods.description: Tests that requests without an authorization token are rejected with an unauthorized status.

methods.name: shouldReturnUnauthorizedIfTokenInvalidTokenPassed
methods.description: Tests that an invalid token string results in an unauthorized response.

methods.name: shouldAllowRequestIfTokenIsValid
methods.description: Tests that a valid JWT token allows access to protected resources.

methods.name: shouldGetUnauthenticatedIfTokenIsExpired
methods.description: Tests that an expired JWT token results in an unauthorized response.

methods.name: shouldReturnJwtAndRefreshTokenWhenProvidedCorrectRefreshToken
methods.description: Tests that providing a valid refresh token returns new JWT and refresh tokens.
